tg.conclusion: Reviewed 0.54.0-0.55.0: tg mentions (phones, e-mail, links, Google documents, and in 0.55.0 known people's names) with confirm, reject, rebuild <kind> and the phone:, email:, url:, domain:, mentions: search fields; mentions in files and voice notes; images embed for picture search; every answer an envelope with snake_case keys; contacts timeline pages; a failing schedule is reported first; files upload from disk without the 2 GiB refusal; unheard voice messages named in missing; tasks link task:<id>; local-only next steps are never auto-run. Roadmap unchanged: several photos in one message, private chat notes and the max-only features remain planned; none of them shipped.

max.conclusion: Reviewed 0.50.0-0.51.0: max mentions (phones, e-mail, links, Google documents) with confirm, reject, rebuild, mentions in files and voice notes and the phone:, email:, url:, domain: search fields; each watch subscriber has its own queue and the largest is cut on overflow; --json=<fields> replaces --fields and --agent-json; tags, tasks and conversations lists take a query; serve keeps the login when closed mid-answer; snake_case error keys; contacts timeline pages; the 2 GiB file and 100-member limits are named. Roadmap unchanged: an optional no-local-copy mode, actions on events, video circles, cloud password and standalone installers remain planned; none of them shipped.

zm.conclusion: Reviewed 0.13.0: contract 3 declares local/remote effects; typed JSONL item/data and end records replace whole answer lines; cursor pages use next_cursor; skipped sources carry completeness/issues, and partial non-search answers return the first source error after printing data. Shared answer, retry and next-step policies are reused. Roadmap unchanged: verified occurrence binding, cited preparation, reviewed findings intake and further shared native archive storage remain planned. Existing Memo notes/tags/aliases and project evidence remain available.
